notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - What's Next
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to introduce our very first Dev Diary for [i]We Will Be Gods![/i][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve had an incredible few weeks since opening the gates to Hamarvast during our first Alpha. Thousands of you stepped into the world, tested its limits, broke a few things (as intended!), and gave us invaluable feedback. Now, as we shift into the next phase of development, we want to bring you along for the ride. [/p][p]These dev diaries are our way of keeping you in the loop by sharing progress and what’s ahead. From new features and balance changes to behind-the-scenes decisions, we’ll be as transparent as possible as we build this world together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539459/aeb1c740bf95efbd6e7dfddeac36cef2f48d4150.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]What's Cooking[/b][/h2][p][b]We have plenty of cool updates and features in the making and here's what we're currently focusing on this summer:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🌀 [b]Teleport system[/b] – [i]Palms sweaty? Knees weak? Arms heavy?[/i] Fast travel is coming! Move quickly across the map.[/p][/*][*][p]🛡️ [b]Barracks & Defensive Units[/b] – Who doesn't love a protective NPC? We've got some amazing little fellas in the making.[/p][/*][*][p]📡 [b]Discord Integration[/b] (Internal POC) – We're experimenting with Discord-linked features so your in-game and community interactions start to blend more seamlessly.[/p][/*][*][p]👁️ [b]Seer Tower[/b] – Your go-to for scouting Elementals and farming runes (among other things!) [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Coming Up: Summer & Fall Sprint Preview[/b][/h2][p][b]Here’s what’s next in our content pipeline:[/b][/p][list][*][p]✨ [b]New Spells[/b] - Tons of exciting new spells in the making! Join our Discord for frequent updates and sneak peeks.[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]Spell Upgrades[/b] - Make your go-to spells stronger! Did someone say tier 2 Fireball?[/p][/*][*][p]🏰 [b]Change Kingdom - [/b]Picked the wrong one? No problem.[/p][/*][*][p]✝️ [b]Resurrection - [/b]Revive and rejoin the fight. Rise, my hero![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These features will roll out during [b]summer and fall[/b], along with more testing opportunities later on.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Check out the artwork featuring our lovable Defensive Units:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539459/9ae57137223133b735f18a3b3abf312a284728ad.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Meet our Barracks:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539459/f0e644e9d19e0243bf1360dfbf5fa3f4deca10c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Don't forget to check out our brand new Story Trailer below![/h1][previewyoutube="SORRaaWcULQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]🤝 Stay connected:[/h2][list][*][p]Join our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=http%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fwewillbegods"]Discord [/url]to follow development, behind-the-scenes and future tests[/p][/*][*][p]Add [i]We Will Be Gods[/i] to your Steam wishlist[/p][/*][*][p]Subscribe to our newsletter on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wewillbegods.com%2F"]website[/url] for updates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North[/p]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest Recap | We Will Be Gods
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Thank You for Playing [i]We Will Be Gods![/i][/b][/h2][p]On [b]May 17[/b], we opened the gates to Hamarvast for the first time. Over two weeks, thousands of players stepped in - and together, we brought the world to life...[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 Alpha by Numbers[/h2][h3]📥 11,000+ sign-ups[/h3][h3]🧡 9,400+ Steam wishlists[/h3][h3]🌍 2 dedicated servers - one in North America and one in Europe[/h3][h3]⏱️ 2.4 hours playtime on average[/h3][h3]📆 3 Seasons[/h3][h3]🏆 Top participants clocking up to 60 hours of testing[/h3][h2]
🏁 Milestones Achieved So Far[/h2][h3]✅ Alpha Launch (May 17)[/h3][h3]✅ Global Servers Deployed (NA & EU)[/h3][h3]✅ 3 Seasonal Test Phases Completed[/h3][h3]✅ Final Playtest Wrapped Up (May 31)[/h3][h3]✅ Player Feedback Collected + Analyzed[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p]Huge milestone for us and for [i]We Will Be Gods[/i], and [b]just the beginning [/b]of what’s to come. From bug reports to suggestions, your feedback has already made a great impact on our development process![/p][p]The final playtest wrapped up on [b]May 31[/b], and we’re now diving deeper into everything we learned.[/p][p][/p][h2] ➡️ What happens next?[/h2][p]We will be implementing more content, new features and continuing to develop the world based on everything we learned during the Alpha. A lot of your feedback aligns with ideas already on our roadmap, and your input continues to shape what we build next.[/p][p]While we don’t have a confirmed date for the next playtest just yet, we’ll be sharing regular updates during the downtime - including behind-the-scenes looks, sneak peeks, Q&As with the dev team, and much more![/p][p][/p][h2]🤝 Stay connected:[/h2][list][*][p]Join our [url="http://discord.gg/wewillbegods"]Discord [/url]to follow development, behind-the-scenes and future tests[/p][/*][*][p]Add [i]We Will Be Gods[/i] to your Steam wishlist[/p][/*][*][p]Subscribe to our newsletter on our [url="https://www.wewillbegods.com/"]website[/url] for updates[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North[/p]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest is Live! | We Will Be Gods
notes.notes:
[h2]The gates to Hamarvast are OPEN![/h2]

Sign up [url=https://wewillbegods.firstlook.gg/]here[/url] to be part of this epic Alpha adventure!

[b]I signed up - what happens next?
[/b]Hang tight! You’ll get a second email asking you to link your Steam ID. A third email will follow with your Steam key.

[b]FAQ:[/b]  
🗓️ Servers will be open from [b]May 17 to May 31[/b] [i](with a slight chance of extension)[/i]  
🌍 We’re starting with [b]1 EU server[/b] for opening weekend — more regions will roll out starting [b]May 19[/b]!  
🔁 Servers reset weekly during Alpha  
🎮 Stay updated and chat with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/dSwnMvy9J2]official Discord community[/url]

[b]Can I stream the Alpha?[/b]  
Absolutely! Stream, share, and spread the word — we’d love to see your adventures.

[h2]Everyone will get to play — invites are just paced![/h2]

This is an early Alpha build, so some features may be missing — but what you’ll see is just the beginning 👀✨  
Expect PvE, PvP, gathering, building, and more — with plenty of surprises coming throughout the Alpha.

The team and I will be active all weekend: playing, streaming, and supporting you on your journey through Hamarvast! ⚔️🚀

❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North

notes.title: New strategy game We Will Be Gods is an ambitious 4X take on League of Legends
notes.notes:
Imagine if you took the core top-down action of League of Legends or Dota 2 and transposed it into a vast, Civilization 7-style hex-grid map, where all your units were real players. It sounds ambitious. But We Will Be Gods developer Cult of the North is making it a reality, and is now looking for willing participants as it prepares to unleash its first round of pre-alpha testing. If you think you're up to the task, you can join the line to try this new free Steam game ahead of its full launch.
